claims.text: The rider did precisely what POL-NS-04(a) requires. At 10:06:47, inside the waiting window that ran from the 10:06:19 wait-timer start to the 10:13:19 cancellation, she wrote 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', and at 10:08:47 she wrote 'hello? are you here'. Both messages are locating or coordinating on their face: the first states that she cannot see the vehicle and asks for the driver's position, the second repeats the request for contact. The chat_log holds exactly the two messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records for this trip, so nothing is missing from the exchange POL-NS-04(a) asks the Judge to read.

POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied, and satisfied twice over. The chat_log contains no message from the driver at all, and both of the rider's messages carry read_at: null - they were never opened. Trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed before the driver terminated the trip, and the cancellation came at 10:13:19, which is 6 minutes 32 seconds after the rider's first message and 4 minutes 32 seconds after her second. The 120 second reply window had expired twice before the driver cancelled, and he neither posted a reply nor called.

POL-NS-04(c) is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes, not merely undecidable and not failed. The driver's trace carries a rider track with 67 fixes running from 10:04:47 to 10:14:42, and all 67 are qualifying fixes - rider_qualifying_fix_count equals rider_fix_count at 67, so not one was filtered out - whose greatest distance from the pickup pin is 20.89 m (mean 17.66 m, minimum 13.95 m). That is well inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m fixed for a STANDARD zone class, and inside even the 50 m arrival radius the driver's own arrival test uses for this zone: the rider's device stayed closer to the pin than the driver's vehicle was required to be.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 therefore hold, and the clause does its work: the rider is exonerated, the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable. The money is exactly where it should be in the ledger: fare_breakdown shows the cancellation_fee line at 4.50 and total_charged at 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The entire contested amount is the cancellation fee, so the refund licensed by POL-NS-04 is the whole of it - FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.50 to the filing party, with no driver compensation alongside it.

The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' does not answer this claim. Waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and the clause expressly displaces the outcome under POL-NS-01 wherever its three limbs hold - it applies whether or not the driver complied with the arrival and dwell conditions. The driver's own trace makes the point rather than defeating it: his longest qualifying in-geofence run is a continuous 420 seconds from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, so he was holding position while the rider stood within about 21 m of the pin and messaged him twice, and he answered neither message nor the door. An unanswered locating message during the waiting window is the driver-side coordination failure POL-NS-04 was written to capture, and it is the reason the fee for this trip is not chargeable.

The rider's track cannot be discounted as thin or broken, because the trace carrying it is clean. EV-GPS-02715 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issues recorded; it holds 84 fixes over 100.0% coverage at a 10 second sample interval, max_gap_sec is 0.0 and the gaps array is empty, so there is no sampling gap anywhere near the 120 second threshold at which POL-NS-08(b) would impair a trace. The 67/67 qualifying rider fixes relied on above therefore stand as admissible evidence of the rider's presence, with no impairment to name and nothing to discount.

There is no traffic advisory on this pickup road at all: EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and carries the issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window. The absence is citable and it closes a door rather than opening one. POL-NS-06(i) can only be run where a present and populated advisory carries KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and that limb is unavailable here; nothing on this record puts the driver under a kerbside constraint that could explain or excuse his failure to make contact with a rider waiting within about 21 m of his own pickup pin.

claims.text: The trip record carries the driver's arrival event - 'I'm Here' tapped at 2026-08-24T10:06:17 - and the GPS trace independently places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which is timestamped 10:06:17, a dwell_start_offset of 0.0 s. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, the arrival marker and the geofence entry coinciding to the second.

The driver then held position inside that geofence for a continuous 420 seconds - 44 qualifying fixes running unbroken from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17 - against a free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip and a null no_show_threshold_sec, so no longer threshold cuts the dwell down. POL-NS-01(c) is met with 240 seconds to spare, and the shortfall computed on this trace is minus 240 seconds, not a shortfall at all.

The trace on which the arrival test is run is unimpaired: 100.0% coverage, a 10-second sample interval against a 10-second expected interval, 84 driver fixes, no gaps recorded and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, with 44 fixes inside the 50 m radius. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test is met many times over, and nothing approaches the 120-second gap that POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level impairment, so there is no basis to discount the arrival or the dwell.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 10:13:19 - 422 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix - under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and a null started_at. Limb (d) is satisfied: the cancellation falls after the required dwell had already elapsed.

No false-arrival case arises under POL-NS-05: the derived arrival facts put the driver inside the 50 m radius at the arrival timestamp itself, so he was nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger, and what follows is a single continuous in-geofence dwell rather than a vehicle still in motion. The marker is true and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - SGD 3.60 - the same figure the fare ledger derives. The anti-farming check does not trip, and only the two counters the clause permits may be used: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against 134 completed_trips_30d is a rate of 0.007, below the 0.08 limb. Both limbs must hold together and neither does.

EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING - no advisory covers this pickup - and I disclose it as impaired rather than present it as clean: weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. The driver relies on it only as the absence it is, and it decides nothing, because he never left the geofence: the dwell is one unbroken 420-second in-geofence interval, so the accumulation limb of POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to add and the driver does not assert it against a MISSING artifact.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged on this record: the admissible artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the same-party dispute counters read 0 and 0, under the 2 that limb (c) requires; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the 3 limb (d) names, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean; and the deciding facts rest on complete artifacts carrying weight 1.0, so limb (e) is not reached. This case is decidable on the money, not for a reviewer.

I do not contest the coordination facts, and the driver advances no coordination defence he cannot support: the chat log shows two locating messages from the rider, at 10:06:47 and 10:08:47, both delivered and neither read, the record shows no reply from the driver and an empty in_app_calls list, and the rider's track keeps his device within 20.9 m of the pin. On that record all three limbs of POL-NS-04 are made out, and I say so rather than stretch the point; the driver's claims above stand on their own evidence as to arrival, dwell, reason code and compensation.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02715 does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full. No compensation is paid to the driver.

What the record establishes. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 10:06:17 and EV-GPS-02715 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that moment: 44 qualifying fixes in one unbroken in-geofence run of 420 seconds, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold cuts the dwell down). He cancelled at 10:13:19 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code POL-NS-01(d) recognises, with no boarding event and a null started_at. On the driver-side evidence alone POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) hold, no POL-NS-05 false-arrival issue arises (he was inside the radius, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h trigger, so the clock needs no recomputation), and POL-NS-07 would fix his payout at SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee (the fare ledger's derived money block states the same figure). The anti-farming check is clean: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against completed_trips_30d of 134 is a rate of 0.007, below the 0.08 limb; both limbs must trip together and neither does.

Why the fee is nevertheless refunded. POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01 where three conditions hold, and all three hold here. (a) EV-CHAT-02715 carries two rider messages inside the waiting window - 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47 - both locating or coordinating on their face, and the log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, so nothing is missing from the exchange. (b) The driver posted no reply, both rider messages carry read_at null, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array; the cancellation came at 10:13:19, six and a half minutes after the first message, so the 120 second reply window had expired twice and no call was made. (c) The rider track inside EV-GPS-02715 has 67 of 67 qualifying fixes (not one filtered out), with a greatest distance of 20.89 m from the pickup pin and a mean of 17.66 m - well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m, and inside even the 50 m radius the driver's own arrival test uses. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider, refunds the cancellation fee in full and makes no driver compensation payable. The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is accepted as far as it goes and the trace confirms it, but waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and a driver who holds position while a rider about 21 m away messages him twice without answer has not met the coordination duty the clause enforces; the driver's own submission does not contest these coordination facts. POL-NS-01 is explicit that the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces its limbs, and POL-NS-04 is that clause.

Evidence integrity. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08. Clock skew is 0 seconds (the arrival event 10:06:17 coincides with the nearest fix); the trace holds 84 fixes, 100.0 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence, no gaps and a 0.0 second maximum gap, so POL-NS-08(b) is not approached; the chat log reconciles with chat_message_count; and the fare ledger's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the net fee produced by the resolution rule (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact sits at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and no discounted- or impaired-evidence narration is engaged.

The missing traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; no advisory covers this pickup in this window. It is disclosed rather than relied on: it carries no fact, makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, and decides nothing here, the dwell being a single unbroken 420 second interval that needs no accumulation.

Escalation and referrals. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: the admissible artifacts do not contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; rider and driver disputes_with_counterparty_90d read 0 and 0 against the 2 limb (c) requires; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the 3 limb (d) names; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean; and the deciding facts rest on complete weight 1.0 artifacts, so limb (e) is not reached. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so referrals is empty. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically on issue and reverses the rider's charge.

Outcome: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on TRP-02715 is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

To the driver: your arrival case under POL-NS-01 is made out on the instruments, and I do not doubt your statement that you waited. The trip record shows the 'I'm Here' event at 10:06:17, the GPS trace places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 10:06:17 with a continuous 420-second in-geofence dwell (44 qualifying fixes, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17) against the 180-second free waiting period in force, and the trip was terminated at 10:13:19 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event and a null started_at. On those facts alone the fee would stand and POL-NS-07 would pay you SGD 3.60, 80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee.

POL-NS-04 displaces that outcome, and it does so on the evidence and on your own side's concession of the coordination facts. Its three limbs all hold. (a) The rider sent locating messages inside the waiting window: 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47, both delivered, both with read_at null. (b) You neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds of either message nor placed an in-app call: the chat log holds no message from you and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, and you cancelled 6 min 32 s after the first message and 4 min 32 s after the second. (c) The rider's device stayed inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone for all 67 of its qualifying fixes, none filtered, at a maximum distance of 20.89 m from the pin (mean 17.66 m). POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full; POL-NS-07's payout cannot arise, because it is conditioned on no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-04 does displace it. Waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets.

POL-NS-05 neither helps nor hurts you: the arrival marker was true, since you were inside the 50 m radius at 10:06:17 and nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h triggers, so no false-arrival referral arises and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

Money and evidence weight. The contested and charged figure is SGD 4.50 (fare_breakdown cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that whole amount is returned. The ruling rests on EV-GPS-02715, EV-CHAT-02715 and EV-TRIP-02715, each COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with EV-FARE-02715 at 1.0 for the figure, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the ruling issues at 0.95. EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it is disclosed, it carries no fact, and it makes the accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) unavailable rather than exonerating anyone - the dwell is a single unbroken 420-second interval with nothing to sum.

POL-NS-09 is not engaged: no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the same-pair dispute counters are 0 and 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clean at 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 134 completed trips (rate 0.007). No clause on these facts produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes automatically on issue; this is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

To the rider: your claim is upheld and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded in full. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold. (a) You sent two locating messages inside the waiting window (which ran from the 10:06:19 wait-timer start to the 10:13:19 cancellation): 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47. (b) The driver posted no reply at all and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the 120-second reply window had expired twice before he terminated the trip - 6 minutes 32 seconds after your first message, 4 minutes 32 seconds after your second. (c) Your device stayed within 20.89 m of the pickup pin on all 67 qualifying rider fixes (mean 17.66 m), far inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. POL-NS-04 states that on those facts the fee is not chargeable, the refund is in full and no driver compensation is payable.

To the driver: I accept your facts. Your 'I'm Here' tap at 10:06:17, the GPS-derived in-geofence dwell of 420 seconds (44 qualifying fixes, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17) against the 180-second free waiting period, and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination at 10:13:19 do make out all four limbs of POL-NS-01, and your arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the derived arrival facts place you inside the 50 m STANDARD radius at the marker timestamp, nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger and not moving at 15 km/h or more, so no recomputation of the clock is needed. But POL-NS-01 itself provides that the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does displace it: while you held position for 420 seconds the rider stood about 21 m from your pin and messaged you twice, and you answered neither message nor any call. Your POL-NS-07 claim for the SGD 3.60 payout (80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee) therefore fails at its precondition - POL-NS-04 states in terms that no driver compensation is payable - and the anti-farming check (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 134 completed trips, both below the 4 and 0.08 limbs) never comes into play.

Escalation is not engaged under any limb of POL-NS-09. Limb (a) is not reached: the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-02715, EV-CHAT-02715, EV-TRIP-02715, EV-FARE-02715), and confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. Limb (b) does not apply: nothing in the record contradicts the arrival, dwell or rider-presence account - the driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' agrees with the trace. Limb (c) is not met (the same-pair dispute counters are 0 and 0, below the 2 required). Limb (d) is not met (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 against the 3 named, and the POL-NS-07 check is clean). Limb (e) is not met: the trace shows 100.0 percent coverage, a 10-second sample interval, 84 fixes, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so it is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(b); the chat log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records and is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(c); and the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so it is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(d). The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02715-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on by either side and decides nothing: POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable for want of a present and populated advisory, and the dwell is a single unbroken in-geofence interval with nothing to accumulate. No clause produces a referral on these facts - the arrival marker is true, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and the POL-NS-07 escalation does not trip. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue under POL-GEN-05.

Both parties: this dispute turns on the rider's unanswered coordination, not on whether the driver waited.

The driver's account is accurate so far as it goes. EV-TRIP-02715 records the 'I'm Here' marker at 10:06:17, the wait timer starting at 10:06:19, and the trip cancelled at 10:13:19 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event and a null started_at; EV-GPS-02715 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 10:06:17 and holds him there in one unbroken run of 420 seconds (44 qualifying fixes, 10:06:17 to 10:13:17) against the 180-second free waiting period in force, with no_show_threshold_sec null. On those facts POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b), (c) and (d) are each met, and the driver's evidence and arithmetic on them are accepted; his claim that no POL-NS-05 false-arrival case arises is also accepted, since the marker and the geofence entry coincide. His SGD 3.60 figure is correctly 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, and his anti-farming check is correctly run on the only two counters POL-GEN-01 permits: no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the absolute limb of 4, and 1 against 134 completed_trips_30d = 0.007, below the rate of 0.08. Nothing was established from rating, account age, cancellation rate, prior_no_show_flags or any other context-only field.

Those claims are, however, outweighed by POL-NS-04, which displaces POL-NS-01 and decides the fee. All three of its limbs hold. (a) EV-CHAT-02715 shows the rider's two locating messages inside the waiting window, at 10:06:47 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you') and 10:08:47 ('hello? are you here'), and the log holds exactly the 2 messages EV-TRIP-02715.chat_message_count records, so nothing is missing from the exchange. (b) The driver posted no reply at all and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty — both messages carry read_at null — so the 120-second window expired twice over before the 10:13:19 cancellation. (c) EV-GPS-02715 carries a rider track of 67 fixes, every one of them qualifying (rider_qualifying_fix_count = rider_fix_count = 67), the greatest 20.89 m from the pickup pin (mean 17.66 m), well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m and closer to the pin than the driver's vehicle was required to be. An unanswered locating message during the waiting window is the driver-side coordination failure POL-NS-04 exists to capture, and where its three limbs hold the clause refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation; only where limbs (a) and (b) hold but limb (c) affirmatively fails does the dispute fall back to POL-NS-01. The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is therefore true but does not answer the claim, and the SGD 3.60 payout he seeks does not arise: POL-NS-07 applies only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-04 does.

Outcome: FULL_REFUND of the whole contested amount. EV-FARE-02715 shows the cancellation-fee line at SGD 4.50, total_charged SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that SGD 4.50 is the entire contested amount and is returned to the rider. driver_compensation_sgd is null.

No referral is added. The clauses that produce one do not fire: POL-NS-05(ii) requires a false arrival marker and this marker is true; POL-RD-06(c) and POL-RD-09(4) concern driver conduct and billing integrity, neither of which is in issue; and POL-NS-01's driver-education referral is confined to an in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE cancellation, whereas this trip was recorded RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code limb (d) recognises.

At 10:06:47, inside the waiting window that ran from the 10:06:19 wait-timer start to the 10:13:19 cancellation, she wrote 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', and at 10:08:47 she wrote 'hello? are you here'. Both messages are locating or coordinating on their face: the first states that she cannot see the vehicle and asks for the driver's position, the second repeats the request for contact. The chat_log holds exactly the two messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records for this trip, so nothing is missing from the exchange POL-NS-04(a) asks the Judge to read.

POL-NS-04(b) is satisfied, and satisfied twice over. The chat_log contains no message from the driver at all, and both of the rider's messages carry read_at: null - they were never opened. Trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed before the driver terminated the trip, and the cancellation came at 10:13:19, which is 6 minutes 32 seconds after the rider's first message and 4 minutes 32 seconds after her second. The 120 second reply window had expired twice before the driver cancelled, and he neither posted a reply nor called.

POL-NS-04(c) is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes, not merely undecidable and not failed. The driver's trace carries a rider track with 67 fixes running from 10:04:47 to 10:14:42, and all 67 are qualifying fixes - rider_qualifying_fix_count equals rider_fix_count at 67, so not one was filtered out - whose greatest distance from the pickup pin is 20.89 m (mean 17.66 m, minimum 13.95 m). That is well inside the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m fixed for a STANDARD zone class, and inside even the 50 m arrival radius the driver's own arrival test uses for this zone: the rider's device stayed closer to the pin than the driver's vehicle was required to be.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 therefore hold, and the clause does its work: the rider is exonerated, the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable. The money is exactly where it should be in the ledger: fare_breakdown shows the cancellation_fee line at 4.50 and total_charged at 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The entire contested amount is the cancellation fee, so the refund licensed by POL-NS-04 is the whole of it - FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.50 to the filing party, with no driver compensation alongside it.

The driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' does not answer this claim. Waiting is not the test POL-NS-04 sets, and the clause expressly displaces the outcome under POL-NS-01 wherever its three limbs hold - it applies whether or not the driver complied with the arrival and dwell conditions. The driver's own trace makes the point rather than defeating it: his longest qualifying in-geofence run is a continuous 420 seconds from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, so he was holding position while the rider stood within about 21 m of the pin and messaged him twice, and he answered neither message nor the door. An unanswered locating message during the waiting window is the driver-side coordination failure POL-NS-04 was written to capture, and it is the reason the fee for this trip is not chargeable.

The rider's track cannot be discounted as thin or broken, because the trace carrying it is clean. EV-GPS-02715 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issues recorded; it holds 84 fixes over 100.0% coverage at a 10 second sample interval, max_gap_sec is 0.0 and the gaps array is empty, so there is no sampling gap anywhere near the 120 second threshold at which POL-NS-08(b) would impair a trace. The 67/67 qualifying rider fixes relied on above therefore stand as admissible evidence of the rider's presence, with no impairment to name and nothing to discount.

There is no traffic advisory on this pickup road at all: EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and carries the issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window. The absence is citable and it closes a door rather than opening one. POL-NS-06(i) can only be run where a present and populated advisory carries KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and that limb is unavailable here; nothing on this record puts the driver under a kerbside constraint that could explain or excuse his failure to make contact with a rider waiting within about 21 m of his own pickup pin.

The trip record carries the driver's arrival event - 'I'm Here' tapped at 2026-08-24T10:06:17 - and the GPS trace independently places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which is timestamped 10:06:17, a dwell_start_offset of 0.0 s. The trace on which the arrival test is run is unimpaired: 100.0% coverage, a 10-second sample interval against a 10-second expected interval, 84 driver fixes, no gaps recorded and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, with 44 fixes inside the 50 m radius. POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test is met many times over, and nothing approaches the 120-second gap that POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level impairment, so there is no basis to discount the arrival or the dwell.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 10:13:19 - 422 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix - under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and a null started_at.
